notes.subject: תקעים
notes.rationale: Hebrew 'striking hands' = sealing a pledge; rendered literally with the custom named.

notes.subject: רע ירוע
notes.rationale: Wordplay: root רעע repeated — 'the bad shall be badly hurt'; most versions lose the pun.

notes.subject: רע/ירוע
notes.rationale: Paronomasia of the same root, lost in Tok Pisin.

translation: Man nogut bai i kim na i pen yet, long wanem em i wanem go long man bilong narapela lain; tasol man i les long ol pasin bilong pasim han wantaim, em i stap isi.
